title: Isharah-Selfie: Continuous Sign Language Recognition Dataset for One-handed Signing
abstract: arXiv:2610.33200v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current sign language recognition and translation benchmarks are commonly collected in controlled settings using fixed or studio-style cameras, particularly limiting their ability to reflect how signers communicate in everyday mobile scenarios. As such, this gap becomes increasingly evident when considering the Arabic Sign Language (ArSL), which is a primary sign language used across Arab countries. In this work, we introduce Isharah-Selfie, a large-scale ArSL dataset collected entirely using front-facing smartphone cameras under unconstrained selfie conditions. The dataset comprises 8,997 video clips performed by 16 signers across 1,493 unique sentences, covering several domains such as healthcare, education, and transportation. translated_title: Isharah-Selfie：面向单手手语的连续手语识别数据集
translated_abstract: 当前的手语识别与翻译基准数据集通常在受控环境下使用固定相机或影棚式相机采集，这极大地限制了其反映手语使用者日常移动场景交流方式的能力。当考虑到阿拉伯手语时，这一差距尤为明显，因为阿拉伯手语是阿拉伯国家广泛使用的主要手语。在这项工作中，我们提出了Isharah-Selfie，这是一个完全使用智能手机前置摄像头在无约束自拍条件下采集的大规模阿拉伯手语数据集。该数据集包含16名手语者录制的8,997个视频片段，涵盖1,493个不同句子，内容涉及医疗、教育和交通等多个领域。与以固定相机、双手手语为主的传统数据集不同，Isharah-Selfie捕捉了以单手手语、近距离视角和部分身体可见为特征的现实移动交流场景。
tldr: 提出了首个使用智能手机前置摄像头在无约束自拍条件下采集的大规模阿拉伯手语连续识别数据集Isharah-Selfie，专门针对现实移动场景中的单手手语识别。
en_tdlr: We introduce Isharah-Selfie, the first large-scale Arabic Sign Language dataset captured via unconstrained selfie conditions using front-facing smartphone cameras, specifically targeting continuous recognition of realistic one-handed signing in mobile scenarios.
